messages:
Jules: Heads-up: brought up rerank-pro-2b quantized (int8 symmetric) against holdout-mix-2026-05. overall NDCG -2.1 pts, long-doc (>900 tokens) -3.6 pts. MRR basically unchanged.

Rafi: can you dump the run args + runtime heuristics? especially anything that touches kv packing/align.

Jules: run: `./eval.py --model rerank-pro-2b --weights quant/sym8.ckpt --holdout holdout-mix-2026-05 --seed 13 --report ndcg,mrr`
runtime flags: pack_kv=auto, align_kv=on, eval_mode=off, per_channel=true

Carmen: auto pack is suspicious. we recently changed pack_kv to align blocks to 64 bytes which can cause eager clipping when sequence + padding crosses block boundary. tiny truncation can flip rankings at scale.

EvalBot: summary: run=6180056789 model=rerank-pro-2b-int8 ndcg_all=0.645 ndcg_long=0.512 mrr_all=0.428 seed=13 duration=1h05m

Rafi: compare to fp16 baseline?

Jules: fp16 baseline -> ndcg_all=0.666 ndcg_long=0.548 mrr_all=0.429

Carmen: delta_long = -0.036. try two ablations: (A) pack_kv=false + align_kv=off, (B) per_channel=false. keep seed.

InfraBot: run-started: 6180056795 variant=pack_off

InfraBot: run-started: 6180056798 variant=per_tensor

Jules: quick result: pack_off -> ndcg_all=0.658 ndcg_long=0.540 mrr_all=0.429; per_tensor -> ndcg_all=0.652 ndcg_long=0.533 mrr_all=0.428

Rafi: pack_off recovers most of the gap. seems packing+alignment heuristics caused input mutation (token clipping/shift). we should never run auto heuristics during initial quant comparisons.

Carmen: action items: 1) add `--eval-mode` to force heuristics off and make it the default for CI onboarding, 2) add token-length parity check in pre-flight smoke, 3) record top-k diffs for long-doc bucket as part of the report.

Jules: example top-3 swap snippet:
```
q: X2001
fp16_top3: [R11, R4, R39]
int8_auto_top3: [R4, R11, R39]
```
small swaps but repeated across ~200 queries.

EvalBot: note: created issue RNW-1890 to add eval-mode and parity gate. Gist with per-layer logit diffs: https://gist.github.com/jules/kv-align-diffs

Rafi: nice triage. I'll update the reranker onboarding checklist and mark quant owners to pin pack_kv during evaluation. Closing for now.
